scripts.//check:supabase-env: Deliberately not part of `verify`. The gate runs credential-free on purpose — that is what proves seed mode still works — so the topology check lives where the real values are: inside `vercel env run` at deploy time.
scripts.//vendor:uploads: The second half of the /admin/colorlab image pipeline: pulls uploaded photographs out of the PRIVATE recipe-uploads bucket into public/recipes and rewrites data/images.seed.json. Readers are never served from Storage — that is what caused the 2026-09-11 egress incident. Commit the result and deploy.
scripts.//: The gate. This is what CI runs and what a developer runs before assuming a change is safe. It chained two more `-w apps/*` gates while CheeseBooth and Sony Live SOP were workspaces here; they are their own repos now and gate themselves.
scripts.//build: `build` is last and is not optional. Lint, typecheck and the suite all passed against a tree whose stylesheet imported a deleted file — none of the three resolves a CSS import, so the app failed to compile with the whole gate green. It is the slowest step, so it runs after the fast ones have had their chance to fail.
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.//supabase-targets: Every script that touches a project takes an explicit --target. There is no default: with two projects in two organisations, a script that reads whichever variables happen to be loaded can write the catalogue into the project that holds Auth.
